description: Ministry of Megapolis and Urban Development - Order to acquire the land in Dehiwala, Dehiwala  Mount Laviniya D/S Division, Colombo District  under  Section 15(1) of the urban Development Authority
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically the vesting of five specific land allotments from the Municipal Council of Dehiwala Mount Lavinia to the Urban Development Authority. It contains detailed descriptions of the properties, including their boundaries, location, and extent. While it mentions a government minister (Patali Champika Ranawaka), the core content is about land transfer and property rights, not about government personnel changes or structural reorganization. The detailed land description and property transfer focus makes this a Land Gazette.
